trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression; interior angle measured at approximately 130 degrees relative to the lobe-center tangents; notch depth is approximately 4% of total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth serrations along the superior-oriented boundary; right lobe contains ~14 distinct pixel peaks; left lobe contains ~11 distinct peaks; peaks range from 2 to 6 pixels in vertical displacement from the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral parabolic convexity sweeping distally and superiorly from the medial axis to the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-intensity (white) pixel cluster located at the extreme distal terminus of the right lobe lobe; secondary smaller high-intensity points visible on the superior edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Atypical high-contrast white patch on the distal tip of the right lobe lobe, distinct from the surrounding low-intensity (black) dorsal pigmentation.
